hints.title: Cyclic Offset Scope
hints.text: An array of length n admits exactly n distinct circular right shift offsets.

hints.title: Shifted Index Arithmetic
hints.text: After shift steps right, the element matching index i of nums2 originates from (i - shift) modulo n in nums1.

hints.title: Offset Enumeration
hints.text: Iterate all n shift configurations and track the maximum count of matching indices.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Tests all n possible shifts with index modulo arithmetic in O(n^2) total time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unconstrained shift exploration without modulo arithmetic causes redundant iterations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space without modifying arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes cyclic shift properties and writes clear modulo indexing.
